ideas.pitch: A real-time synchronization dashboard designed for 4-person teams to split sub-tasks during sudden surprise gauntlet challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: About the Event Think a hackathon is just pick a problem, open your laptop, and start coding? Think again. Welcome to Zero Hour — a hackathon where coding is only part of the game.
ideas.title: GauntletSync: Multi-User Collaborative State Relay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core constraint of Zero Hour: coordinating 3 surprise gauntlets assigned to 3 different team members under severe time limits.

ideas.pitch: A command-line tool that lets developers rapidly apply pre-configured patch templates to breakages during timed emergency sprints.
ideas.problem_statement: About the Event Think a hackathon is just pick a problem, open your laptop, and start coding? Think again. Welcome to Zero Hour — a hackathon where coding is only part of the game.
ideas.title: RapidPatch: Automated Code Hotfix Injector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact panic scenario when things stop going according to plan and teams need quick fixes during the 3-hour build window.

ideas.problem_statement: About the Event Think a hackathon is just pick a problem, open your laptop, and start coding? Think again. Welcome to Zero Hour — a hackathon where coding is only part of the game.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to judges looking for adherence to the rule that at least 3 different team members must participate in the gauntlet challenges.

ideas.pitch: An ultra-minimalist countdown dashboard equipped with an integrated slide generator for the final judge pitch.
